```{r read-data, paged.print=FALSE, results='hold'}
sed26 <- read.csv("YZsedsAll.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
sed26$Sample.ID <- as.character(sed26$Sample.ID)
sed26$XRD.Sample.ID <- as.character(sed26$XRD.Sample.ID)
# names(sed26)[43] <- "Fe.phases"
# summary(sed26)
(summDF <- data.frame(Variable=colnames(sed26),
                      Has.NA.values=sapply(sed26, function(x){sum(is.na(x))>0}),
                      n.Missing=sapply(sed26, function(x){sum(is.na(x))}),
                      row.names = NULL))
```

```{r CLR-transformation-and-wrangling, paged.print=FALSE}

noNA <- colnames(sed26)[which(summDF$n.Missing==0)]
numCols <- colnames(sed26)[which(sapply(sed26, is.numeric))]
(keep <- c(colnames(sed26)[1:5],"Flag",intersect(noNA, numCols)))
#check it
cat("Should be the same!\n")
colnames(sed26[,keep])

# make a copy of the relevant columns from the data
s26_clr <- sed26[,keep]
                                                              cat("\n\n")
# select just the elements since their names have either 2 or 3 characters
(elements <- colnames(sed26[,keep])[colnames(sed26[,keep]) %in% colnames(sed26)[which(nchar(colnames(sed26))<3)]])

# do CLR transformation to remove compositional closure
s26_clr[,elements] <- 
  t(apply(s26_clr[,elements], MARGIN = 1,
          FUN = function(x){log(x) - mean(log(x), na.rm=T)}))
                                                              cat("\n\n")
# check missing value count in numeric columns
sapply(s26_clr[,which(sapply(s26_clr, is.numeric))], function(x){sum(is.na(x))})

# the next code not used yet as we don't have enough XRD data

# s26_clr[,43:46] <- t(apply(sed26[,43:46], MARGIN = 1,
#                           FUN = function(x){log(x) - mean(log(x))}))
# head(s26_clr) # ; summary(s26_clr) ; nrow(s26_clr) ; nrow(na.omit(s26_clr))
# RcmdrMisc::numSummary(s26_clr[,6:ncol(s26_clr)])

```

```{r PCA-on-elements}
# do PCA on CLR-transformed elemental concentrations
pca2 <- prcomp(s26_clr[,elements], scale. = TRUE)

# show variable weightings for first 8 principal components (PCs)
{cat("\nVariable weightings\n")
pca2$rot[,1:8] |> round(3)}

# display component variances (eigenvalues)
{cat("...\n\nComponent Variances - CLR-transformed (open) data\n")
  print(round(pca2$sdev^2,3))}

# display proportions of variance explained by successive PCs
{cat("...\n\nProportions of variance explained by each component\n")
  round(pca2$sdev^2/sum(pca2$sdev^2),3)}

# display cumulative proportions of variance explained by PCs
{cat("...\n\nCumulative proportion of variance explained by each component\n")
  cumsum(round(pca2$sdev^2/sum(pca2$sdev^2),3))}
```

```{r summarise-PCA-eigenvalues, results='asis'}
cat("\nThere are",sum(round(pca2$sdev^2,3)>1), "principal components with eigenvalues greater than 1."); cat("\nThese",sum(round(pca2$sdev^2,3)>1), "components together explain",100*cumsum(round(pca2$sdev^2/sum(pca2$sdev^2),3))[sum(round(pca2$sdev^2,3)>1)],"% of cumulative multiple variance.")
```

```{r PCA-elements-XRD-screeplot}
# plot a scree plot (variance vs. component) also showing variance=1
plot(pca2); abline(h=1, lty=2, col="#8080ff80")
axis(1, at=seq(0.7,11.5,l=10), labels=c(1:10)); mtext("Component",1,2,font=2)
```

```{r biplots-observations-by-location-and-size, fig.width=12.8, fig.height=12.8, paged.print=FALSE}
# make factor
s26_clr$LocSieve <- paste0(s26_clr$Loc,"-",s26_clr$Sieve)
s26_clr$LocSieve <- as.factor(gsub("-NA","",s26_clr$LocSieve, fixed=T))

# set up colours and graphics parameters
palette(c("black", turbo(16, alpha=0.7),"white"))
par(mfrow=c(2,2), mar = c(3.5,3.5,3.5,3.5), oma = c(0,0,0,0),
    mgp=c(1.7,0.3,0), tcl = 0.25, font.lab=2, cex.lab=1.2, cex.axis=1.1,
    lend = "square", ljoin = "mitre")

# FIRST BIPLOT --------------------------------------------------------
# choose components and set scaling factor (`sf`) & symbol sizes (`szs`)
v1 <- 1; v2 <- 2; sf <- 0.98; szs <- rep(c(1.4,1.3,1.2,1.2,1.2),l=16)*1.2

# plot standard PCA biplot but hiding observation scores ("transparent")
biplot(pca2, choices = c(v1,v2), col = c("transparent","black"), cex=c(1,1.18)*sf,
       pc.biplot = FALSE, arrow.len = 0.08, cex.lab=1.2*sf, scale=1, 
       # change xlim, ylim if needed, to show all data
       #xlim = c(-0.6,0.6), ylim = c(-0.6,0.6), 
       xlab = paste0("Scaled PC",v1," Component Loadings"),
       ylab = paste0("Scaled PC",v2," Component Loadings"))

# add top and right axis labels
mtext(paste0("Scaled PC",v1," Observation Scores"), 3, 1.4, font = 2)
mtext(paste0("Scaled PC",v2," Observation Scores"), 4, 1.4, font = 2)

# add observation scores to plot; different symbols/colours by `LocSieve` factor
points(pca2$x[,v1]*sf, pca2$x[,v2]*sf*1.5,
       pch = rep(c(21:25),l=16)[s26_clr$LocSieve],
       lwd = 1, bg = c(2:17)[s26_clr$LocSieve],
       col = 1,
       cex = szs[s26_clr$LocSieve])
box() # redraw plot frame just in case ;^)

# add a legend
plot(0:1,0:1, type="n", axes=F, ann=F, bty="n")
legend("left", cex=1.2, ncol=2, inset=0.02, box.col="#888", bg="#ffffff40",
       legend=gsub("."," ",levels(s26_clr$LocSieve),fixed=T),
       pch=rep(c(21:25),l=16), pt.bg=c(2:17), pt.cex=szs*sf*1.2)
text(0,0.15, labels=paste("Br = bridge","\nCP = Car Park","\nDS = downstream",
                         "\nFB = firebreak","\nUS = upstream"), pos=4, cex=1.2)

# SECOND BIPLOT ------------------------------
# choose components and set scaling factor (sf)
v1 <- 3; v2 <- 4; sf <- 0.8

biplot(pca2, choices = c(v1,v2), col = c("transparent","black"), cex=c(1,1.18)*sf,
       pc.biplot = FALSE, arrow.len = 0.08, cex.lab=1.2*sf, scale=1,
      # xlim = c(-0.6,0.6), ylim = c(-0.6,0.6),
       xlab = paste0("Scaled PC",v1," Component Loadings"),
       ylab = paste0("Scaled PC",v2," Component Loadings"))
mtext(paste0("Scaled PC",v1," Observation Scores"), 3, 1.4, font = 2)
mtext(paste0("Scaled PC",v2," Observation Scores"), 4, 1.4, font = 2)
points(pca2$x[,v1]*sf, pca2$x[,v2]*sf*1.5,
       pch = rep(c(21:25),l=16)[s26_clr$LocSieve],
       lwd = 1, bg = c(2:17)[s26_clr$LocSieve],
       col = 1,
       cex = szs[s26_clr$LocSieve])
box()

# add a legend
plot(0:1,0:1, type="n", axes=F, ann=F, bty="n")
legend("left", cex=1.2, ncol=2, inset=0.02, box.col="#888", bg="#ffffff40",
       legend=gsub("."," ",levels(s26_clr$LocSieve),fixed=T),
       pch=rep(c(21:25),l=16), pt.bg=c(2:17), pt.cex=szs*sf*1.2)
```

# Linear Discriminant Analysis Prediction

## 1. Train with everything except pool bottom (core) sediments

```{r do-initial-LDA-predict-train-with-sources, paged.print=FALSE}
# 1. add PCs to data frame 
s26_clr <- cbind(s26_clr, pca2$x[,1:12])

# train with everything except pool bottom sediments
LDAdata <- droplevels(s26_clr[s26_clr$Type!="sink",])

# 2. run linear discriminant analysis (LDA) to predict factor level from PCs
lda1 <- lda(Loc ~ PC1+PC2+PC3+PC4+PC5+PC6+PC7+PC8+PC9+PC10, 
            data=LDAdata) # for cross-validation include , CV=TRUE
print(lda1)

# show LDA predictions
cat("\n\nLDA self-predictions\n====================\n")
lda1.pred <- predict(lda1) # won't work if CV=TRUE is included in lda(...)
predRslt <- data.frame(Actual=LDAdata$Loc,round(lda1.pred$post,4),
                       Predicted=colnames(lda1.pred$posterior)[apply(lda1.pred$posterior,1,
                                                                     function(x){which(x==max(x))})],
                       check.names = F)
predRslt$correct <- predRslt$Actual==predRslt$Predicted
# colnames(predRslt)[2:5] <- c("Ara.2mm","Ara.63µm","McN.2mm","McN.63µm")
print(predRslt, row.names=F)
```

### 1.1 Predict where pool bottom sediments came from...

```{r}
lda.pred2 <- predict(lda1, newdata=s26_clr[s26_clr$Type=="sink",])
predRslt2 <- data.frame(Actual_Sample=s26_clr[s26_clr$Type=="sink","Sample.ID"],
                       Predicted=colnames(lda.pred2$posterior)[apply(lda.pred2$posterior,1,
                                                                     function(x){which(x==max(x))})],
                        round(lda.pred2$post,4),
                       check.names = F)
# predRslt2$correct <- predRslt2$Actual==predRslt2$Predicted
# colnames(predRslt2)[2:5] <- c("Ara.2mm","Ara.63µm","McN.2mm","McN.63µm")
print(predRslt2, row.names=F)
```

## 2. Train with only terrestrial sediments (car park, firebreaks, riparian soil)

```{r do-initial-LDA-predict-train-with-erosional, paged.print=FALSE}
# 1. add PCs to data frame 
s26_clr <- cbind(s26_clr, pca2$x[,1:12])

LDAdata <- droplevels(s26_clr[s26_clr$Type=="erosional",])

# 2. run linear discriminant analysis (LDA) to predict factor level from PCs
lda1 <- lda(Loc ~ PC1+PC2+PC3+PC4+PC5+PC6+PC7+PC8+PC9+PC10, 
            data=LDAdata) # for cross-validation include , CV=TRUE
print(lda1)

# show LDA predictions
cat("\n\nLDA predictions\n===============\n")
lda1.pred <- predict(lda1) # won't work if CV=TRUE is included in lda(...)
predRslt <- data.frame(Actual=LDAdata$Loc,round(lda1.pred$post,4),
                       Predicted=colnames(lda1.pred$posterior)[apply(lda1.pred$posterior,1,
                                                                     function(x){which(x==max(x))})],
                       check.names = F)
predRslt$correct <- predRslt$Actual==predRslt$Predicted
# colnames(predRslt)[2:5] <- c("Ara.2mm","Ara.63µm","McN.2mm","McN.63µm")
print(predRslt, row.names=F)
```

```{r visualise-lda, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}

         length = 0.08, col = "grey60")
  }
text(lda1$scaling[,1]*1.1, lda1$scaling[,3]*1.1, 
     labels=row.names(lda1$scaling[,1:2]),
     cex = 0.9, col = 1, pos=c(1,2,3,4), offset = 0.01)
points(lda1.pred$x[,1]*sf, lda1.pred$x[,3]*sf, 
       pch=rep(c(21:25),l=6)[lda1.pred$class],
```

# Random Forest Prediction

```{r random-forest, paged.print=FALSE}
rf1 <- randomForest(LocSieve ~ ., 
                data=s26_clr[, c("LocSieve", "PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "PC5", 
                           "PC6", "PC7", "PC8", "PC9", "PC10", "PC11", "PC12")], 
        classwt = as.numeric(summary(s26_clr$LocSieve))/nrow(s26_clr), 
        # tuning parameters
        mtry=6,
        ntree=1000,
        nodesize=1,
        maxnodes=10,
        sampsize=10,
        replace=FALSE,
        )
# str(rf1)
rf1
rf1predSumm <- data.frame(Actual=s26_clr$LocSieve, Predicted=rf1$predicted, Correct=(s26_clr$LocSieve==rf1$pred))
cat("\n","   Random Forest prediction summary","\n",rep("=",38),"\n",sep="")
print(rf1predSumm, row.names = F)
```


# Support Vector Machine Prediction

```{r support-vector-machine}
sv1 <- svm(LocSieve ~ ., 
                data=s26_clr[, c("LocSieve", "PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "PC5", 
                           "PC6", "PC7", "PC8", "PC9", "PC10", "PC11", "PC12")], 
        ## TUNING PARAMETERS
        cost=2,     # default = 1
        gamma=0.05, # default is 1/(number of predictors) # 1/12 = 0.083
        # degree=3, # only for polynomial kernel # see help for others
        # leave this one 👇
        kernel="radial" # kernel can be "linear" or "polynomial"
        )
# str(sv1)
print(sv1)
sv1pred <- predict(sv1, s26_clr[, c("LocSieve", "PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "PC5", 
                           "PC6", "PC7", "PC8", "PC9", "PC10", "PC11", "PC12")])
cat("\nPredictions from Support Vector Machine\n",rep("=",39),"\n",sep="")
print(data.frame(Actual=s26_clr$LocSieve, Predicted=sv1pred, Correct=(s26_clr$LocSieve==sv1pred)))
```

# Gradient Boosting Prediction

A gradient-boosted _tree_ classifier is the only option for classifying 
non-numeric categories.

```{r gradient-boosting-tree}
gbTree1 <- xgboost(x=s26_clr[, c("LocSieve", "PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "PC5", 
                           "PC6", "PC7", "PC8", "PC9", "PC10", "PC11", "PC12")],
               y=s26_clr$LocSieve, 
        ## TUNING PARAMETERS
        objective = "multi:softprob", # ... default for factor with >2 levels
        eval_metric = "logloss",          # default "logloss" for classification
        nrounds = 100L,               # default 100 (L means integer)
        max_depth = 6,                # default 6
        learning_rate = 0.3,          # default 0.3 for tree booster
        reg_lambda = 1,               # default 1 for tree booster
        booster="gbtree"
        )
# str(gbTree1)
# print(gbTree1)
gbTree1pred <- predict(gbTree1, s26_clr[, c("LocSieve", "PC1", "PC2", "PC3", "PC4", "PC5", 
                           "PC6", "PC7", "PC8", "PC9", "PC10", "PC11", "PC12")])
cat("\nPredictions from Gradient boosting (linear)\n",rep("=",43),"\n",sep="")
gbTree1summ <- data.frame(Actual=s26_clr$LocSieve, 
                 Predicted=colnames(gbTree1pred)[unname(apply(gbTree1pred, 1, 
                                  FUN=function(x){which(x==max(x, na.rm=T))}))])
gbTree1summ$Correct <- gbTree1summ$Actual == gbTree1summ$Predicted
print(gbTree1summ)
```

```{r stepwise-LDA-on-Principal-Components}
# based on just the suspended sediment samples 
# (i.e. having non-NA s26_clr$LocType3)

# run `stepclass()` multiple times to get greatest accuracy score

steplda2 <- stepclass(s26_clr[,c("PC1","PC2","PC3","PC4","PC5","PC6","PC7","PC8","PC9","PC10","PC11","PC12")], 
                  grouping=s26_clr$LocSieve, 
                  method="lda", criterion="AC", improvement=0.005) # AC=accuracy
print(steplda2)
(lda2 <- lda(LocType3 ~ PC2+PC3+PC5+PC8+PC9+PC10+PC12, 
             data=s26_clr[!is.na(s26_clr[,48]), ]))
ldapred <- predict(lda2)
trainChk <- data.frame(Actual=as.character(s26_clr[!is.na(s26_clr[,48]), 48]),
      Predicted=as.character(ldapred$class))
trainChk$is.Correct <- trainChk[,1]==trainChk[,2]
print(trainChk)
```

```{r stepwise-LDA-on-Measured-Variables}
# based on just the suspended sediment samples 
# (i.e. having non-NA s26_clr$LocType3)

# run `stepclass(...)` multiple times to get greatest accuracy score
lda0step <- stepclass(s26_clr[!is.na(s26_clr[,48]),5:46], 
                  grouping=s26_clr[!is.na(s26_clr[,48]),48], 
                  method="lda", criterion="AC", improvement=0.001) # AC=accuracy
(lda0 <- lda(LocType3 ~ Pb + U + Er + Mo + La, 
            data=s26_clr[!is.na(s26_clr[,48]), ])) # accuracy: 0.99993
ldapred0 <- predict(lda0)
trainChk <- data.frame(Actual=as.character(s26_clr[!is.na(s26_clr[,48]), 48]),
                       Predicted=as.character(ldapred0$class))
trainChk$is.Correct <- trainChk[,1]==trainChk[,2]
print(trainChk)
```

```{r pred-bottom-seds-by-LDA-for-susp-seds, paged.print=FALSE}
# predict bottom sediments from lda model for suspended sediments
ldapred02 <- predict(lda0, newdata=s26_clr[is.na(s26_clr[,48]),5:46])

postLDA0 <- data.frame(BotSed=as.character(s26_clr[is.na(s26_clr[,48]),47]),
                       round(ldapred02$posterior,3))
row.names(postLDA0) <- paste0(row.names(postLDA0),"_",postLDA0[,1])
(postLDA0 <- postLDA0[,2:5])
```
